geometryDescription: Statistical mean of 19 asymptomatic adult CT-derived meshes; LV wall segmented, source RV and atrial thicknesses prescribed. No LAA or fine trabeculae.
orientation: Inferred +X patient left, +Y posterior, +Z superior from chamber centers and SVC/IVC; original source coordinates retained without transform.

lvLateralNearestEndoEpiDistanceMm.definition: Nearest Euclidean distance from mid-LV lateral endocardial nodes to epicardial nodes; a geometric distance check, not a formal normal-wall thickness measurement.

surfaceMethod: vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter on myocardial tets only; per-chamber topology-preserving DecimatePro retains original source-node positions.
cutMethod: Intersections of original myocardial tetrahedra with an oblique four-chamber plane fitted through chamber means and LV apex; exact edge interpolation; topology-preserving cap decimation retains original edge intersections. Cap holes are actual ventricular/atrial lumens.
